**THE AKRON DAILY BEACON**

**VOL. 1, ISSUE 1**

**JULY 3RD, 2014**

**AKRON VANISHES IN FLAMES; CITY LEFT IN RUINS**

In a bizarre and inexplicable event, the city of Akron, Ohio, has spontaneously combusted, leaving behind a smoldering crater and a population of bewildered residents who seem to have forgotten the entire ordeal.

Eyewitnesses describe the scene as "apocalyptic" and "surreal," with flames engulfing the city's skyline and a massive cloud of smoke billowing into the air. "I was just walking to work when suddenly the city was on fire," said Jane Doe, a local resident. "I didn't think much of it at first, but then I realized that everyone was just... gone."

As the city burned, the landscape around it began to change, as if the very fabric of time and space was unraveling. Trees regrew, rivers flowed, and the air was filled with the sweet scent of blooming flowers.

"I was driving home from work when I saw the city go up in flames," said John Smith, a local business owner. "I thought it was some kind of prank, but then I saw the trees growing back and the rivers flowing again. I didn't think much of it at first, but then I realized that I had no idea what year it was."

As the days pass, residents of Akron are struggling to come to terms with what has happened. Many are reporting strange visions and memories that seem to be from a different time period. "I keep seeing a guy in a funny hat and a pair of overalls," said Sarah Johnson, a local resident. "I have no idea who he is or what he's doing here."

The city's government has issued a statement assuring residents that they are doing everything in their power to investigate the cause of the disaster. "We are working tirelessly to determine what happened to the city of Akron," said a spokesperson. "In the meantime, we urge residents to remain calm and to report any further strange occurrences."

As the city begins to rebuild, residents are left to wonder what the future holds. Will they ever be able to return to their old lives? Or will they be forced to adapt to a new reality?

* **REBUILDING EFFORTS:** The city is working to rebuild and restore the area, but residents are struggling to come to terms with what has happened.

**INTERROBANG:** What just happened to the city of Akron?!
